proof_0265.moves: Unwrap the bundled DTreeMap into its underlying Impl (projection `inner` plus the well-formedness field `wf`) and apply the already-proved Impl-level statement that the first component of containsThenInsertIfNew is `contains`. All the mathematics lives in the Impl lemma; this layer is pure wrapper transport.

proof_0266.moves: The lattice inf on `Opens` is defined as intersection of the underlying sets, so the coercion equation holds definitionally: the entire proof is `rfl` against the `CompleteLattice` instance on `Opens`.

proof_0267.moves: A HashSet is a HashMap with Unit values, so unwrap through `inner` and apply the corresponding HashMap statement about `getKey!` on a union when the key is absent from the left map. No new mathematical step.

proof_0268.moves: Provide the HasFactorization instance by invoking the existence theorem that every morphism of SimplexCategoryGenRel factors as a P_σ followed by a P_δ, destructuring the resulting existentials to get the middle object and the two morphisms, repackaging them as MapFactorizationData (flipping the factorization equation), and wrapping in Nonempty.

proof_0269.moves: Split the iff and prove each direction by the transfer lemma that convergence passes along a pair that tends to the uniformity filter; the reverse direction first symmetrizes the uniformity hypothesis.

proof_0270.moves: Start from the fact that eventually x > a along atTop (available because the order has no top), and weaken pointwise with the implication x > a implies x ≠ a.

proof_0271.moves: Specialize the general `apply_sup_eq_sup_comp` lemma to a linear order, where the required hypothesis (the map sends binary sups to sups) is exactly `Monotone.map_sup` — monotone maps into a linear order automatically preserve joins.

proof_0272.moves: Finsets of a fintype form a Boolean algebra, so the set-theoretic statement s ⊆ tᶜ ↔ t ⊆ sᶜ is just the order-theoretic `le_compl_iff_le_compl` transported through that instance.

proof_0273.moves: The underlying coalgebra hom of a composite coalgebra equivalence is by construction the composite of the underlying homs, so the proof is `rfl` unfolding `CoalgEquiv.trans`.

proof_0274.moves: A presented group is by definition the quotient of a free group by the normal closure of the relations, so the canonical map is surjective by the general surjectivity of a group quotient map.

proof_0275.moves: `Finset.sup` is a fold of `max` starting at ⊥; since max is idempotent, the fold-over-insert lemma applies without needing a ∉ s, giving f a ⊔ s.sup f directly.

proof_0276.moves: The topology on PUnit is literally defined to be the bottom topology, so constructing the DiscreteTopology instance amounts to supplying `rfl` for its single field.

proof_0277.moves: Unwrap the HashMap to its underlying DHashMap via `inner` and apply the corresponding dependent-map statement about `get!` on a union when the key is not in the right map. Pure wrapper transport.

proof_0278.moves: The right-hand side is the literal unfolding of the definition of `LowerHemicontinuousOn`, so the iff holds by `Iff.rfl`. The content is definitional, not deductive.

proof_0279.moves: Take x in the support of the product, reduce membership in the indexed intersection over s to a pointwise statement, and argue contrapositively: if some factor vanishes at x then the whole product vanishes at x, contradicting x being in the support.

proof_0280.moves: `Pi.single i a` is `Function.update 0 i a`, so the image of a single-coordinate Ico is exactly the specialization of the general `update` image lemma; the only step is recognizing that identification.

proof_0281.moves: Unfold retrocompactness: given an open compact U, reassociate (s ∩ t) ∩ U as s ∩ (t ∩ U), note t ∩ U is open (intersection of opens) and compact by the hypothesis on t, then apply retrocompactness of s to it. The associativity rewrite is the actual manipulation.

proof_0282.moves: Take a point of the image, destructure the witness x with its membership and the defining equation, then case-split (the `dite` in the representative function) on whether x lies in the relevant part: in the first branch the value lands where required by `apply_mem`, in the second the junk-value lemma `apply_of_notMem` handles it. The real content is the witness destructuring plus the case split.

proof_0283.moves: A perfect number is in particular pseudoperfect (it is the sum of a sub-collection of its proper divisors, namely all of them), and a prime is not pseudoperfect since its only proper divisor is 1; chain the two.

proof_0284.moves: Push through the ExtHashMap wrapper via `inner` and apply the corresponding ExtDHashMap statement that the left-intersection is empty. No independent argument.

proof_0285.moves: The primitive character attached to any Dirichlet character is primitive; apply that general theorem to the product character on the lcm of the moduli.

proof_0286.moves: Repackage the bundled DHashMap as a `Raw₀` — its `inner` raw map paired with the positivity-of-bucket-count proof via `Subtype.mk` — and apply the Raw₀-level `get_eq_getD` with the well-formedness hypothesis. Entirely representation transport.

proof_0287.moves: Direct restatement of the dependent-hash-map fact that a map created with a given capacity contains no keys; the HashMap version is that theorem verbatim.

proof_0288.moves: In the lexicographic-style order on a sum, an inr element is never below an inl element, and the LocallyFiniteOrder instance on Sum is defined so that this interval computes to the empty finset; hence `rfl`.
